items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Frank Cuny, my piano player, luckily for me that he could tune the pianos.

ctx.x: It's just one of those nights I didn't play night and day.

You don't know what a band leader goes to. You've got to be smiling when you feel like, you know. But after all, I think I'd do it again. Yeah? Yes, I loved it. And you've got to love music to play. You've got to love music to play in places where the piano is so bad that you turn the back of the piano to the people and tell the piano player, knock the head of note all night, and he sits there and gets his dope, how do you like that? If you ask him to tune the piano and they're $15 or $20, you don't want to spend…
